# The White House

> The official website of the White House providing comprehensive access to Trump administration policies, executive actions, news, and government operations.

This site serves as the primary digital hub for the Trump administration, offering real-time news coverage, official policy documents, executive orders, presidential actions, and direct communication channels. It features investment tracking, declassified historical records, and detailed fact sheets on key initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Executive Orders
- Presidential Actions
- Trump Administration
- Government Policy
- National Security
- Economic Policy
- International Relations
- AI Framework
- Election Integrity
- SAVE America Act
- Nominations & Appointments
- White House News
- Policy Announcements
- Declassified Documents
- Fraud Prevention

## Presidential Actions & Executive Authority

- [Presidential Actions](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions): Index of executive orders, proclamations, and presidential nominations
- [Executive Orders](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/executive-orders): Complete collection of Trump administration executive orders
- [Presidential Memoranda](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/presidential-memoranda): Presidential memoranda on national security, technology, and fiscal policy
- [Nominations & Appointments](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/nominations-appointments): Presidential nominations and Senate-confirmed government appointments

## News & Communications

- [News](https://www.whitehouse.gov/news): White House news hub with transcripts, proclamations, and press releases
- [Live News](https://www.whitehouse.gov/live): Live news coverage and video content from White House events
- [Briefings & Statements](https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefings-statements): Official White House briefings, statements, and announcements
- [White House Wire](https://www.whitehouse.gov/wire): News roundup hub with trusted news sites and policy announcements
- [Articles](https://www.whitehouse.gov/articles): Articles on government operations, policy announcements, and executive actions

## Policy & Initiatives

- [Investments Tracker](https://www.whitehouse.gov/investments): Tracker of private and foreign investments in US manufacturing, tech
- [The SAVE America Act](https://www.whitehouse.gov/saveamerica): Information on SAVE America Act for election integrity and voter security
- [Fact Sheets](https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets): Fact sheets on Trump administration policies and government initiatives

## Analysis & Special Reports

- [Lab Leak: The True Origins of Covid-19](https://www.whitehouse.gov/lab-leak-true-origins-of-covid-19): White House analysis of COVID-19 origins and Wuhan Institute of Virology
- [January 6: A Date Which Will Live in Infamy](https://www.whitehouse.gov/j6): White House statement on January 6 events and presidential pardons
- [Criminal Aliens Receiving Medicaid](https://www.whitehouse.gov/criminals): Trump administration report on criminal aliens receiving Medicaid benefits

## Declassified Historical Records

- [JFK Files](https://www.whitehouse.gov/jfk-files): Declassified JFK assassination records and government documents archive
- [RFK Files](https://www.whitehouse.gov/rfk-files): Declassified RFK assassination records and historical government documents

## Engagement & Access

- [The White House Homepage](https://www.whitehouse.gov): Official White House homepage with Trump administration priorities
- [Contact Us](https://www.whitehouse.gov/contact): Contact form to share thoughts with President Trump and VP Vance

## Optional

- [Gallery](https://www.whitehouse.gov/gallery): Photo gallery of White House events and presidential activities
